description: This file defines an Angular component named DocumentViewComponent that provides a detailed view for a document, including functionalities to view, edit, invite collaborators, and remove collaborators. The component interacts with DocumentService to perform data operations and integrates other components like DocumentEditorComponent and DocumentCollaboratorsComponent.

classes.name: DocumentViewComponent
classes.description: An Angular component providing a detailed interface for viewing, editing, and managing collaboration on documents within the application.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, subscribes to route parameters to load the document based on its ID, and determines if the component is in edit mode based on the URL.

methods.name: loadDoc
methods.description: Fetches the document details from the DocumentService by document ID and updates the component state.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles the save event from the editor component, updating the document via the DocumentService and exiting edit mode.

methods.name: onInvite
methods.description: Handles the invite event from the collaborators component, calling the DocumentService to invite a new collaborator.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removal of a collaborator, updating the document's collaborators list and notifying the DocumentService.
